plain_language.what_this_is: The worker/provider and model list the app offers in chat. This is a plain, EDITABLE config so PCC does not silently assume one worker forever. Pick the default worker here, and edit each provider's model list as the CLI surfaces change.
plain_language.how_to_update: Edit default_provider if the main worker changes. Update the per-provider model lists below as the available model IDs change. Claude still supports a fallback chain; Codex in this first slice is a one-shot text worker path.
